text:
Sam (People Ops): Short manager checklist + 30/60/90 one-pager I made for busy leads. Use as handout.

Priya: Nice. Can you throw in a tiny calendar skeleton?

Sam (People Ops): Added — lean times, record where useful, optional async standup.

Alex: Please include an access escalation matrix (who to DM if GitHub/Okta/cloud stuck).

Sam (People Ops): Added: @it-support urgent / @infra-ops cloud perms / cc @sam for blockers.

Jordan: Recommend a "handoff by day 7" signoff so hires aren't left hanging after week 1.

Sam (People Ops): Good call — added a quick manager signoff checklist for day 7.

Taylor: Also make the buddy vs manager roles explicit.

Sam (People Ops): Done. Single-page text below (copyable).

Sam (People Ops): ```
MANAGER WEEK0 (20-30min)
- Send welcome email + calendar invites (day0 logistics, day1 1:1, team intro, buddy checkin)
- Create access ticket: Okta group, Slack, GitHub team, Drive, cloud role
- Prep 3 priority outcomes for first 90 days (share on day1)
- Pick a buddy and confirm availability for week1 pairing

DAY1 (keep <4 meetings)
09:30-10:30 Manager 1:1: role, scope, 3x90 goals, immediate priorities
11:00-11:30 Team intro: 2-min intros, org map, key contacts (recordable)
14:00-14:30 Buddy session: env + runbook + first PR pairing
16:30-16:45 Manager close: quick pulse + blockers

DAYS2-5
10:00 15min daily huddle (live or async) 
Schedule two focused deep dives: product domain, infra/dev loop

ACCESS ESCALATION MATRIX
- GitHub: @dev-platform (DM) -> @it-support (if org invite issue)
- Okta/Slack: @it-support (DM) -> cc People Ops
- Cloud roles: @infra-ops (DM) -> create ticket if cross-team

DAY7 MANAGER SIGNOFF (3 bullets)
- New hire can push a small change or PR with guidance
- Buddy confirms core dev env + tests running
- Manager gave 30-day feedback and set next priority

WHO DOES WHAT
- Manager: outcomes, context, priorities, feedback cadence
- Buddy: tools, repo walkthroughs, ad-hoc pairing, local norms
- People Ops: payroll, benefits, laptop orders, access escalation support

30/60/90 (single line each)
- 30d: orient, ship a small fix, meet cross-functional partners
- 60d: own a feature, improve a test/CI flake, incident readout
- 90d: lead an end-to-end project, propose a measurable perf/cost or quality win

QUICK SETUP NOTES
- Mac: after VPN run `curl -sSL https://redwood.tools/setup | bash`
- Linux: `./scripts/bootstrap-dev && ./scripts/run-local`
- If laptop provisioning stalls: DM @it-support and tag @Sam
```

Priya: This is compact and shipable. Can you paste a PDF link once it's in the repo?

OnboardBot: Laptop order created, ETA 3 business days.

Sam (People Ops): Will upload PDF+MD to onboarding repo and drop link here. Ping me for team-specific edits.

Alex: Using this for my hire next week. Thanks!
